messages:
alice_support: heads-up — customer ACME reported errors and duplicate billing after upgrading to python-sdk 1.32.0. They say auth fails intermittently and retries double-charge. Ticket #4572 attached.
carol_sdk: thanks, can you paste the minimal repro and any client logs they gave?
alice_support: pasted from customer (redacted):\n```\n# pip freeze\npython-sdk==1.32.0\nrequests==2.31.0\n# python snippet\nfrom redwood import Client\ncli = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))\nresp = cli.generate(model='gpt-small', prompt='hello')\n```\nand stack: `TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'timeout_ms'` followed by `HTTP 401` then a couple of `409` charges reported by billing.
carol_sdk: hmm, timeout_ms error suggests the client is passing legacy arg names into the new transport layer. 1.32 changed timeout handling and renamed `timeout_ms` -> `timeout`. Also changed retry wrapper order which can cause duplicate retries when server returns 401->retry->client replays non-idempotent request. not great.
dave_billing: customers are seeing two charge events within seconds. looks like idempotency header not being attached for POSTs in the new retry flow. If retries replay without Idempotency-Key we double bill for non-idempotent endpoints.
alice_support: customer confirms they didn't set Idempotency-Key explicitly. They were relying on client to set it in previous versions.
carol_sdk: ok repro plan: run the same snippet with 1.31.5 and 1.32.0, hitting sandbox that returns 401 then 200, and check request headers. I'll run locally and report.
carol_sdk: (run)\n```bash\n# test with pinned versions\npython -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate\npip install python-sdk==1.31.5\npython repro_script.py # hits /v1/generate mock\n```\ncarol_sdk: result: 1.31.5 client sets `Idempotency-Key` on initial request and on retries; retry logic is idempotency-aware (retries only replay safe payload). 1.32.0 drops header during internal auth refresh -> server treats retry as fresh request -> duplicate charge.
alice_support: customer asked for mitigation until we patch. suggested pin? any other workaround?
carol_sdk: recommend pinning to 1.31.5. Quick workaround if they must stay on 1.32: set env var `REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTORETRY=1` or configure client: `Client(retry_config={'max_retries':0})` and set `Idempotency-Key` manually for each request. Both are safe but degrade reliability.
eve_pm: can we do a fast patch release? this looks high severity — billing impact.
carol_sdk: I will open a hotfix branch. plan: restore idempotency header across auth refresh and make retry wrapper idempotency-preserving. target cut: 1.32.1 within 48h. PR linked to ticket.
dave_billing: set escalation: billing ops to contact affected customers and issue manual refunds where duplicates occurred. slate a billing audit for the last 24h for endpoints /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings.
alice_support: relayed workaround to ACME: pin to 1.31.5 (`pip install 'python-sdk==1.31.5'`) or use manual Idempotency-Key + disable autoretry. they accepted temporary pin.
carol_sdk: reproduction notes saved in the bug: request headers show `Authorization: Bearer ...`, `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` present in 1.31.5 but missing from retry replay in 1.32.0. root cause: retry wrapper was moved below auth-refresh step in middleware stack.
deploy_bot: deployment scheduled to staging 23:40 UTC for canary tests of 1.32.1-hotfix.
carol_sdk: action items: (1) ship 1.32.1 hotfix; (2) add automatic test to ensure idempotency header preserved across auth-refresh; (3) notify customers and docs to pin when experiencing billing anomalies. assigning @carol_sdk to PR and @eve_pm to customer comms.
alice_support: thanks all — closing internal triage. will reopen if customer sees anything after pin.
